resources.string: Optional and local: a one-second downmixed audio scratch buffer is used in memory only, then cleared after feature extraction. No audio is saved or sent. HDMI passthrough is never analyzed or changed. Suggestions always require your confirmation.

When enabled, Omniverse checks TheIntroDB using a public title ID, episode, and runtime. If an IPTV series has no ID, it may search TVmaze using the series title and year to find an IMDb ID. TVmaze sees that title/year, but neither service receives a stream URL or provider login. Ambiguous matches are ignored. Results are not guaranteed. Online markers follow the Intros and Credits choices below: Off, Show button, or Auto-skip. TVmaze data is used under CC BY-SA.
Auto-skip uses saved points or source markers. New local suggestions always need your confirmation.

When on, the public TMDB ID of a title is sent to Wikidata, then its Rotten Tomatoes page is fetched to show the critics and audience scores. No stream URL, provider login or viewing history is sent. Turn off to stop these requests.
Fill missing plot and cast from Wikidata

When on, a title with missing details sends only its public TMDB ID to Wikidata and Wikipedia. No stream URL, provider login or viewing history is sent. Details from your provider always come first, and Wikipedia plots are credited on screen.
Hold OK on a row to move it · Up/Down · OK or Back to drop. OK toggles a row on or off.
Bigger text for viewers sitting farther from the TV. Applies to menus, lists and titles; posters and layout keep their proportions. Applies per profile and takes effect immediately.

Live and final scores on Sports cards show as \"Score hidden\" until you press OK on a card, which reveals that game\'s score for the rest of your visit. Hold OK on any game to follow a team: its games then lead the Sports page and Home. Applies per profile.

Omniverse can be your TV screen saver: on Android TV open Settings › Device Preferences › Screen saver and pick Omniverse. It pans slowly across poster art of your Continue Watching titles and recently added movies and shows, crossfading every few seconds, with the clock and date in the corner. Titles hidden by parental controls or switched-off libraries never appear, and nothing is fetched beyond artwork your catalog already has.
Favorites, watch history and lists are kept separate for each profile.
Deleting a profile removes its favorites, watch history and lists.
You are using Omniverse without a profile. Everything you watch is still saved, and creating a profile takes it all over.
Deleting the last profile turns it into the Guest - favorites, watch history and lists are all kept.
A Kids profile hides locked categories everywhere with no PIN unlock offered, and switching out of it asks for the parental PIN.
Only time spent watching counts. When the limit is reached the player pauses, and the parental PIN adds 30 more minutes.
Only time spent watching counts. Between %1$s and %2$s the player pauses, and the parental PIN adds 30 more minutes.
Delete this profile? Its favorites, watch history and lists are removed.
Delete this profile? Omniverse keeps all your sources, settings and watch history and continues without a profile.
Asked at startup when more than one profile exists. If the last used profile is a Kids profile, the app starts straight into it instead.

Ask the TV to run at the video\'s frame rate — 24 fps films on 24 or 48 Hz, 25 fps on 50 Hz, 30 fps on 60 Hz — for smoother motion. Seamless only switches only when the TV can do it without a blank flash. Always also switches live TV and, on older TVs, may flicker or briefly blank at playback start. The resolution never changes. Each profile keeps its own choice.

When on, live TV keeps a second hidden stream ready on the next channel (the direction you last zapped) so Up/Down changes feel instant. It never opens more than one extra connection, and it turns itself off for the session if your provider refuses the extra stream (too many devices). Turn off if your provider allows only a single connection.

When on, episodes you haven\'t watched yet (after the last one you watched) show a blurred thumbnail and hide their description in show details — press OK on one to reveal it. Episode titles stay visible unless "Also hide episode titles" is on. "Up next" cards and the player\'s next-episode card drop the episode title too. Applies to this profile only.
